body.name: Occupancy-weighted full-fiber projection handle
body.construction: Apply \(H_{\mathrm{occ}}\) at \(r=\rho_\star\): solve finite two-fiber minimax tests on nested Hölder sieves; extract each test's first nonzero localized Hoeffding projection; replace an unnormalized all-pairs sum by \(S_{\mathrm{occ}}\); clip record projections at their public concentration envelope; rescale each target score to replacement sensitivity one; and pass the resulting \(Q_t\) to the ordered target-shell selector.
